# Bloxley (Bloxley US inc.)

Bloxley is a Financial Services company. Bloxley is a hyperbanking start-up that offers financial services to help customers revolutionize their banking experience. Bloxley employs 14 people (+23.1% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including Bangladesh, United States, Indonesia, Philippines, and United Arab Emirates). Has $5.1M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

## About

We're driven by a clear mission: empowering people and their money by putting them first. Bloxley makes modern U.S. banking accessible through our intuitive, secure and mobile-first platform.

Our diverse team of 25+ has created seamless money management for users across 4 countries and expanding. From global transfers to 100+ countries and zero-fee peer-to-peer payments to advanced measures to combat unauthorized and authorized fraud, 24/7 human support and more, every feature is designed for handling everyday finances and beyond.

With strategic partnerships and strong regulatory frameworks, we're scaling innovative banking across international markets.
